headSHASemantics: This is the local implementation and focused-test commit.
scope: Clarify local renderer package import in the existing Renderers settings UI without changing package validation or storage behavior.

success: The Renderers settings UI identifies local package import as an advanced action.
The UI explains that one local package folder is validated and copied for use on this Mac.
The UI states that it does not use the selected source folder after import.
boundary: The picker accepts one directory and rejects files, archives, and multiple selections at its validation boundary.
The UI does not expose an app-managed destination path.

excluded: Package storage, package validation, machine index semantics, registry refresh behavior, and renderer session pins
Hosted Settings window and VoiceOver runtime validation
Remote distribution, signing, archives, and package catalog work
